Happier Patients.
More Revenue. Really.

Our embedded, AI-powered patient financing solutions drive a 30% increase in patient payments, and our patient satisfaction is over 50% higher than the average for other companies in the industry. With PayZen, you really do get the best of both worlds.

See How It Works

Trusted by hospitals and health systems, of all sizes

Patient Financing Solutions Done Right

PayZen’s AI-powered financing solution delivers long-term, personalized payment plans—aligned with each patient’s ability to repay and always interest-free, fee-free, and administratively simple, unlike traditional patient financing companies.

Learn More

A consistent, embedded
digital-first experience

Patients can enroll in under a minute through our fully embedded self-service healthcare payment platform, or you can offer the same affordable financing solutions through your staff experience.

AI-powered intelligent payment
options and advanced servicing
technology

Our underwriting uses AI and 30,000 data points to guarantee relevant offers, resulting in a 78% enrollment success rate. Our state-of-the-art servicing keeps patients on track.

Seamless integration and
end-to-end automation

PayZen leads the way in patient financing solutions with technology that’s implemented in weeks—not months. Our pre-built EMR integrations and automated workflows reduce administrative burdens on healthcare organizations.

Future-proof your business with an
ever-expanding technology platform

While we got our start as a patient financing company, PayZen’s vision is broader than breaking large balances into monthly payments. We are building an integrated, data-driven platform that automates manual processes to holistically address the affordability needs of patients, resulting in an overall revenue increase for providers.

Pre-Service Care Card

Remove financial barriers to receiving great care, increase point-of-service collections, and drive loyalty. PayZen’s Care Card enables flexible patient financing solutions for pre-service and recurring use.
